rule: All laptop or desktop purchases exceeding $2,500 require VP-level approval.
Any SaaS vendor handling PII or Customer Data must have a verified SOC2 Type II report on file.
New vendors must be vetted for 'Sustainability and Ethical Sourcing' if the contract value is >$10k.
Marketing expenses over $500 cannot be charged to personal credit cards; must use a corporate PO.
GPU compute credits (AWS/GCP/Azure) exceeding $5k/month require CTO-Infrastructure approval.
